# KCUR

> KCUR 89.3 FM is Kansas City's NPR-affiliated public radio station delivering breaking news, in-depth journalism, and diverse podcasts covering local politics, sports, culture, and community issues.

KCUR serves the Kansas City metropolitan area with comprehensive coverage of Missouri and Kansas news, including politics, education, housing, health, and sports. The station operates KCUR Studios, a podcast network featuring daily news briefings and specialized shows on topics ranging from local history to environmental sustainability.

## Key Topics

## Breaking News & Coverage

- [KCUR Homepage](https://www.kcur.org): KCUR 89.3 homepage with breaking news and NPR coverage for Kansas City
- [News Hub](https://www.kcur.org/news): Kansas City news hub with breaking stories and regional coverage
- [Politics, Elections and Government](https://www.kcur.org/politics-elections-and-government): Politics and government coverage from Kansas Legislature and Missouri Assembly
- [Education](https://www.kcur.org/education): Education coverage across Kansas City, Kansas and Missouri schools
- [Health](https://www.kcur.org/health): Health news and issues affecting Missouri and Kansas communities
- [Housing & Development](https://www.kcur.org/housing-development-section): Housing affordability and development news for Kansas City region

## Podcasts & Audio

- [KCUR Studios](https://www.kcur.org/kcurstudios): KCUR Studios podcast directory with local news and diverse content
- [Kansas City Today](https://www.kcur.org/podcast/kansas-city-today): Daily 15-minute news podcast hosted by Nomin Ujiyediin
- [SportsBeat KC](https://www.kcur.org/sportsbeat-kc): Weekly sports podcast covering Chiefs, Royals and Kansas City teams
- [A People's History of Kansas City](https://www.kcur.org/a-peoples-history-of-kansas-city): Historical podcast about everyday heroes and visionaries shaping Kansas City
- [Up From Dust](https://www.kcur.org/up-from-dust): Environmental podcast exploring sustainability in Kansas breadbasket
- [KCUR Weekly Radio Schedule](https://www.kcur.org/kcur-weekly-radio-schedule): KCUR 89.3 FM and Classical KC weekly radio programming schedule

## Sports & World Cup

- [World Cup: Kansas City](https://www.kcur.org/world-cup-kansas-city): 2026 FIFA World Cup coverage and Kansas City host city preparations
- [Sports](https://www.kcur.org/sports): Kansas City sports coverage including Chiefs, Royals and World Cup

## Arts, Culture & Community

- [Arts & Life](https://www.kcur.org/arts-life): Arts, culture, music and dining coverage from Kansas and Missouri
- [History](https://www.kcur.org/history): Historical stories and heritage from Kansas City and Midwest
